sentences.text: Dorea formicigenerans is the species formed when Eubacterium formicigenerans was reclassified into the new genus Dorea, alongside Dorea longicatena from human faeces.
The organisms are Gram-positive, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming rods of the Clostridium coccoides ribosomal RNA group.
A feruloyl esterase from this gut species was expressed and characterised; such enzymes release hydroxycinnamic acids such as ferulic acid from dietary fibre.
Its complete genome is one circular chromosome of 3,090,452 base pairs with 40.8 percent GC content and 3,061 predicted genes.
